title: The count beneath the route before supper
body: A road is rubbed out on the map, while six small figures remain beside it. The pencil has worn through the paper at the place where they waited. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.

title: Supplies for an empty seat before supper

title: Two directions in one fold before supper
